load_json_files: load all JSON files from a directory into a list of Python objects
load_json_file: load the contents of a single JSON file into a Python dictionary or list
save_json_file: save a Python object as a JSON file to the specified file path
load_json_file_then_transform: load a JSON file and transform its data into a different structure
save_json_file_with_nested_data: save a nested Python dictionary as a formatted JSON file to disk
